property_summary: For every input to setL1BlockValues, the reference contract stores basefee equal to the provided _basefee; the mutant stores basefee = _basefee + 1 for most inputs, thereby violating that equality for any _basefee where _basefee + 1 != _basefee (i.e. all values except uint256.max).
change_summary: Replace assignment to basefee with assignment of basefee + 1, changing stored basefee value after call.
